_readme: The ONE map of the kit's local state. Scripts never build these paths by hand: PowerShell Get-KitPath (kitpaths.ps1, dot-sourced by kitconfig.ps1), Python kit_path (kitpaths.py), Node kitPath (kitpaths.mjs) and each workflow's rp() helper all resolve names from here (kit-lint RUNTIME-RAW / RUNTIME-MAP enforce it). 'runtime' entries live under <runtime> = $CLAUDE_RUNTIME, else <kit>/.claude-runtime, and are disposable: work/ = in-flight runs, cache/ = rebuilt on demand, logs/ = append-only logs; deleting the folder loses nothing durable. 'durable' entries live at the kit root, git-ignored (*.local.*): knowledge and task state that must survive a runtime wipe. Folders end in '/'.
